items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Nick Kenny, you ever hear of Nick Kenny? ... Nick Kenny, he was a columnist in the news or something and he wrote lyrics for songs.

ctx.x: But it’s on a discography, Benny made a record and others. Bad thing. And so this little girl [screeches scats] well you could fall on the floor, even when I was a kid I said, “boy that’s pretty terrible,” scratching I mean. So we all did the thing, and I made the auditions. And I sang on the radio twice, can you imagine? Now I don’t remember whether it was the Amateur Hour program or whether they put the winning amateurs on some bigger program. But the strange thing was — what did I sing and how did I pick it? I…
